title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Mission Flight Plan. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Mission Flight Plan
options.lineage: Apollo-era flight plans, checklists and go/no-go polls
options.thesis: Your career filed as a flight plan: every venture a mission, every claim logged with its time and evidence.
options.viewport: A flight-plan cover: condensed caps headline, a COMPANY / PRODUCT / TECHNOLOGY go-poll, crew photo as Fig. 1, LinkedIn in view.
options.risk: Costume risk if the space metaphor goes past documentation into rockets and stars; it has to stay paper, not sci-fi.

raised.raise: The platform chapter is a stepped schematic that draws the six shared services on as you scroll.
Every outcome prints as a measured before→after row drawn to scale (5–6 months → 4 weeks).
Status prints itself as timestamped log lines, never as badges or pills.

options.label: The Exhibit File
options.thesis: A career read like a filing: numbered exhibits, action titles, ruled tables and a source line under every claim.
options.viewport: Exhibit 1: action title, a three-row outcome table, portrait plate.
options.risk: Familiar: it's where most runs for an exec audience land, and it borders the editorial-serif rut. It also echoes your Exhibit deck.

options.label: Hand-drawn Zine
options.thesis: Your platform taught like a friend sketching it.
options.viewport: Marker headline over a doodled spine diagram.
options.risk: Boards and investors read it as junior.
options.case: Builders like it; boards and investors don't recognize themselves in it, and it isn't clearer.
options.kept: Stepped draw-on diagram for the platform chapter.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.viewport: A blinking prompt typing your bio.
options.risk: A developer costume; narrows you to CTO.
options.case: Hides the CEO and CPO story behind a tool costume.
options.kept: States print themselves as log lines.

options.label: Forge & Hammer
options.thesis: Built to Last, literally hammered out.
options.case: Loses both axes: no audience lives in a forge.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.thesis: Career as night breaking into day.
options.viewport: Black stage with a cobalt horizon band.
options.case: Atmosphere without proof; loses on clarity.
options.kept: The page progresses in phases the way a lighting cue does.

options.label: Zoot Handbill
options.viewport: Stacked billing caps in a scalloped border.
options.kept: Billing order as hierarchy: the strongest proof leads.

options.label: Telop Captions
options.thesis: Numbers shouting at their own volume.
options.kept: Type scale tracks a number's magnitude.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The executive personal site, done impeccably: portrait, headline, logo strip, case studies.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and CTA left, portrait right, logo row under.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other exec site by design.
